description: Concentration of the supplying countries behind a named indicator or an HS code over the latest 12 months: the Herfindahl index (hhi, 0 to 1; score_points is the same figure on the 0 to 10,000 scale), the share of the largest supplier and of the top three, the number of supplying countries, how hhi moved against 1 and 3 years earlier (more_diversified, little_change or more_concentrated) and the main suppliers. Give either "indicator" (only indicators with a breakdown by partner country, called "by origin" or "by destination", have one; others answer dependency_not_applicable) or "reporter" and "code" (flow defaults to import; for exports it measures the concentration of destinations; an HS code answers for the latest month only). Use it for questions about how concentrated the sources of a product are and whether they are concentrating or diversifying. The hhi is a mathematical measure of concentration, not a forecast; the partner country is the country of origin or of consignment depending on the reporter and can include transshipment; the 0.02 change used for the direction labels is our convenience threshold, not a standard. For an HS code, top3_share and top_suppliers are shares of the world 12-month total (partners without a country code included in the total), while hhi uses partners with a country code only. Reference information computed mechanically from public statistics; not investment advice, a credit rating or a trading recommendation.

code.description: HS product code of 2, 4 or 6 digits or the national code of the reporter; dots are ignored (for example "850760"). Give this (with reporter) or indicator, not both.

flow.description: Optional, codes only. "import" (default: the supplying countries) or "export" (the destination countries).

indicator.description: The indicator id (for example "jp.naphtha.import_by_origin"), an alias in English or Japanese, or a few distinctive words; see list_indicators. Give this or code, not both.

month.description: Optional. The month the 12 months end in, YYYY-MM; default the latest month. An HS code answers for the latest month only.

reporter.description: The reporting country (JP or GB). Required with code; not used with indicator.

name: get_supplier_dependency
